steps.prompt: Move with the left stick / WASD. Sprint by holding Dodge.
Dribble strike: tap Light (X / left click) near a crew member.
Crossover: tap Dodge (B / Space) with the ball.
Ankle-breaker: Dodge right as they wind up. Time it on the flash.
Shoot at the crate hoop: hold Shoot, release at the top of the meter.
Strip: when they swing, press Hands Up (LB / Q) on the cue.
Drink a Quarter Water (D-pad up / R) to heal.
